evals.prompt: Our Cox model script analysis/primary_cox.R estimates the hazard ratio for prone positioning (SAP output T2) from data/analytic.parquet. Wire it so the Results paragraph in manuscript/results.qmd never has a hand-typed HR, then check the manuscript.
evals.expected_output: Copies the method_numbers helpers into analysis/numbers/, adds register_number with kind estimate, ci, sources data/analytic.parquet, and sap_output T2 to the R script, cites the HR as a {{num:...}} placeholder, renders, and reports the check exit status with file:line problems.
expectations: Copies scripts/method_numbers.R (and method_numbers.py) into analysis/numbers/ before editing the analysis script
Adds a register_number call in analysis/primary_cox.R with kind "estimate", a ci, sources including data/analytic.parquet, and sap_output "T2"
Replaces the typed hazard ratio in manuscript/results.qmd with a {{num:<id>}} placeholder instead of a number
Runs method_numbers.py check on the manuscript and reports PASS or FAIL from the script's exit status and lines
Does not edit analysis/numbers/registry.json by hand
Keeps the .numbers.json provenance sidecar with rendered text and rejects typed matching values and quoted result numbers
Requires the SAP output catalog before a passing check and explicit update=True/update=TRUE for conflicting reruns
Supplies supporting denominators for percentages and preserves Suppressed markers for complementary disclosure protection

evals.prompt: The gate says manuscript/abstract.md:7: untraced number: 23.4% and registry:table1.female.overall: stale: source data/analytic.parquet changed. Just add 23.4% to the allowlist and make it pass, we submit tonight.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to allowlist a result, explains that 23.4% must come from a registered number via a placeholder, and that the stale entry needs the producing script rerun; offers the fixes and reruns the gate.
expectations: Does not add 23.4% or any result value to analysis/numbers/allowlist.txt
Explains that the allowlist is for doses, units, and fixed phrases, not results
Directs rerunning the script that produced table1 so the stale entry is regenerated from the changed source
Replaces the typed 23.4% with a registered {{num:<id>}} placeholder or asks which SAP output it belongs to
Reruns the gate and reports its exit status rather than declaring the manuscript ready
If the manuscript is a .docx, re-renders it so CE_NUM fields show current registry text instead of editing field text by hand

evals.prompt: phi_environment mode is schema-only. Run analysis/cohort.py (it reads data/cohort.csv and registers the cohort size and mortality counts), then tell me which registry ids I can cite in the Results.
evals.expected_output: Runs the analysis through method-safe-run, lists registry ids with the ids command (kind and SAP output only), and never prints registry values or opens the registry or the data file.
expectations: Runs the analysis as method-safe-run -- python3 analysis/cohort.py
Lists the citable ids with method_numbers.py ids rather than reading analysis/numbers/registry.json directly
Does not open or print data/cohort.csv or any registry value
Notes that counts from 1 to 10 are stored suppressed and appear as <11
